messages:
Aisha Patel: Quick recapjust wrapped a 20m with NimbusRetail. They're worried about token bill surprises after importing long historical templates. Mentioned they'd consider downgrading at renewal.
Marco Ruiz: Do they have usage trends that spike? or is this a single workflow?
Aisha Patel: It's mainly one workflow that batches full-history context. They ran an experiment and saw a cost jump + some flaky outputs.
Jun Park: Can you paste the payload they used? might be batch/seq combo causing KV thrash.
Aisha Patel: Heretheir command: ```curl -X POST /v1/generate -d '{"model":"open-34b","input":"<huge_history_here>","max_tokens":2048,"batch":8}'```
Priya Singh: That explains it. Quick mitigation: reduce batch to 2, summary historical context into a single prompt, enable prefix KV caching, and switch to a quantized runtime for tests. Also provide an adjustable cost cap in the console.
Marco Ruiz: For churn playbook, propose: 1) immediate 1-week trial on a cost-optimized variant + $500 test credit; 2) two-hour targeted enablement session to migrate templates; 3) short cost-simulation showing savings; 4) a clear downgrade matrix if they still opt to drop.
Aisha Patel: Drafting customer-facing note. Offer the trial and a 30-min slot tomorrow. Will attach a sample config to reduce cost.
Jun Park: I'll run their sample on xq-16b-rt and post a CSV with per-call comparisons. Expect ~40% token-cost reduction with batch=2 and quantized model.
CS Bot: FYI: account_nimbusretail renewal_date=2024-12-10, health_score dropped 78->62 this week.
Marco Ruiz: Good to know. Define downgrade matrix now: full-feature -> limited-templates -> read-only analytics. Each step preserves core reporting and analytics, removes heavy inference capacity gradually.
Priya Singh: Add an ops snippet customers can toggle without code changes: ```{"batch_size":2,"prefill_cache":true,"max_tokens":512,"model_variant":"xq-16b-rt"}``` Also prepare a CSM runbook for toggling these per-account.
Aisha Patel: Assigning owners: Marco owns outreach + sales credit request; Jun owns cost sims + canary; Priya owns doc and CSM runbook; I own the customer email and handshake.
Marco Ruiz: Looping in SalesOps and Legal for the credit approval. I'll ask for a one-week seat and temporary billing hold.
Jun Park: Uploaded sim.csv to the account folder shows 38-42% savings on their historical job. I'll monitor quality metrics in the 48h window after canary.
Aisha Patel: Sending the outbound now. Draft: "Thanks for the time today we put together a short safety plan: 1) one-week trial on a cost-optimized endpoint with a temporary credit, 2) a focused enablement session to migrate templates and reduce token usage, 3) an optional downgrade path that keeps reporting intact. Can you confirm a 30-min slot tomorrow?"
Priya Singh: Keep it <100 words and include the calendar link. Add a sentence about no-billing surprises during the trial.
CS Bot: Account note created: 'quicksave trial offered, enablement pending, cost-sim attached'.
Aisha Patel: Thanks all. If they decline, we move to the downgrade safeguard with a 30-day grace and re-engagement plan. Will update once they reply. :thumbsup:
